name: cadence-premium
vibe: A calm, premium SaaS film authored for 9:16. Warm cream paper, terracotta and sage, heavy rounded display type over soft product cards that rise and settle rather than slam. Sixteen authored surfaces — search, setup, board, thread, digest, metrics, pricing — each a real interface moment rather than a text slide. Unhurried and expensive-looking. For SaaS, productivity, workflow and team tools that want to read considered instead of loud.
